name: WireGuard VPN
author: P3lu
description: WireGuard VPN widget for the Omarchy bar: left-click opens a themed status panel with live IP/gateway/peer/last-handshake/ping/loss/throughput details, connect/disconnect via nmcli, and one-click import of your .conf into NetworkManager. DNS is read-only (the config's own DNS, to avoid leaks).

barWidget.description: A themed WireGuard panel (state, IP, gateway, peer, handshake, ping, loss, up/down speed) plus one-click connect/disconnect and config import via nmcli.
